correctness.rationale: Reconstructed 60 unoriented Hamiltonian six-cycles as elements of S6 modulo inversion, Kirkman incidence as ordered pairs of edge-disjoint six-cycles (three partners each), hence exactly 180 flags. S6 acts equivariantly; full eleven cycle-type spectra and splitting degrees follow by finite permutation action. Independently enumerated 60 hexagons and 180 flags, compared (6),(3,3),(4,2),(2,2,2) orbit tables and confirmed all eleven types; inspected source verify_hexagrammum.py, which exhausts all 720 permutations and checks exact projective 60+60 realization over Q and F10007. Geometric Kirkman concurrence is an explicitly credited classical premise, no claim of existence for every small finite field. Zeta product is exact finite-etale orbit formula. Independent checks substantiate finite computation without extrapolating examples into universal geometry.
